findings.title: @Transactional ignored on self-invocation
findings.description: recordAudit is annotated REQUIRES_NEW but is invoked through this from finalizeInvoice; Spring's proxy is bypassed, so the annotation is ignored and the audit row commits or rolls back together with the invoice instead of independently. Move it to a separate bean or use TransactionTemplate.
findings.suggestion: Extract recordAudit into its own @Service (injected), or wrap the call in a TransactionTemplate with PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW.
